actions.result_status: City Council approved Resolution 0072-01-25 authorizing the development agreement with QTS Cedar Rapids I, LLC for a data center campus along 76th Ave SW.

actions.evidence_note: Supersedes baseline caveat that only the Alliant announcement was accessible.
